title: yamada component ledger releases
description: Ordered MATLAB releases known to the component ledger. The surface release is the one whose surface the ledger's records describe; it is audited and its ledger lives in the directory of the same name. Availability and overrides in the ledger describe every other listed release. Runtime catalogs are generated for audited and verified releases only.

status.description: audited: the surface release, reviewed property by property. verified: annotations checked against native controls of that release; a catalog is generated. known: release notes only; no catalog is generated and the loader serves the newest older catalog.
